sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress version 5.2 or higher (tested up to 6.7)
  • PHP version 7.3 or higher

Automatic Installation

Installing Poptics automatically is simple because WordPress handles everything.

  • Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  • Go to “Plugins” on the left menu and click “Add New”.
  • In the search bar, type “Poptics.”
  • Click “Install Now” next to the Poptics plugin.
  • After the installation, click “Activate” to enable the plugin.

Manual Installation

You can also install Poptics manually by downloading the plugin and uploading it to your website.

  • Download and unzip the Poptics plugin.
  • Use an FTP client or CPanel to upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/ in your WordPress directory.
  • Go to Plugins in your WordPress dashboard and activate the plugin from the list.

Upgrading

Poptics updates automatically, but if you’ve customized the plugin, make a backup before updating. Sometimes, updating can cause permalink issues.

To fix permalink issues:

  • Go to “Settings > Permalinks” in WordPress.
  • Click “Save Changes” to refresh the settings.
sections.faq:
📌 Is Poptics beginner-friendly?

Yes. Poptics is designed for beginners and non-coders. With the drag-and-drop popup builder and ready-to-use templates, you can create professional popups without any coding skills.

📌 Does Poptics work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. You can create WooCommerce popups for upsells, cross-sells, product promotions, and abandoned cart recovery campaigns.

📌 Can I create exit-intent popups?

Yes. Exit-intent popups are built-in and can help recover abandoning visitors before they leave your site.

📌 Is it mobile responsive?

Yes. All Poptics popups are fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

📌 Can I integrate Poptics with my email marketing tool?

Yes. Poptics integrates with Mailchimp, FluentCRM, Zapier, Pabbly, and ActiveCampaign.

📌 Does Poptics have analytics?

Yes. The built-in analytics dashboard lets you track views, clicks, conversions, and run A/B tests (Pro) to improve campaign performance.

📌 Can I run A/B testing on my popups?

Yes. With Poptics Pro, you can create multiple variations of a popup and test which design, headline, or offer performs best using built-in A/B testing tools.

📌 Is Poptics a good Popup Maker alternative?

Yes. Poptics offers similar features to Popup Maker but with a modern interface, faster performance, and a library of optimized templates.
